set.body:
Problem:
Response readers fill a primitive flat array, expand it into Vector[Vector[Double]], and DMat.fromRows copies it element by element into another flat buffer.

Scope:
- Add an ownership-explicit row-major DMat constructor over the matrix's native primitive NArray[Double] storage.
- Validate positive rows/columns and exact rows*columns length without copying.
- Allocate the final primitive buffer directly in NiftiResponseBlockSource and CompositeResponseBlockSource.
- Remove matrixFromRowMajor's nested-vector conversion while preserving the public idiomatic DMat.fromRows path.
- Document adoption/mutation ownership so the zero-copy boundary is not ambiguous.

Acceptance:
- The response-block hot path contains no Vector.tabulate or Vector[Vector[Double]] materialization.
- Arbitrarily ordered time/voxel selections return the same values and metadata as before.
- Shape mismatch and invalid-dimension construction fail at the construction boundary.
- imageJVM/test, imageJS/test, datasetJVM/test, and datasetJS/test pass with explicit tolerance-based floating checks.
- A focused allocation/code-path assertion demonstrates one final primitive response buffer rather than flat -> boxed -> flat conversion.
set.title: NIfTI hot path: add an owned primitive row-major DMat boundary
